text: I stand behind ACT_NOW on the new high: W and D HH/HL, 0.45% under the 20-wk high, a brand-new high in an Upward Trend (C16). I filed close_above:high_52w_close on D; the ticket's h1_close_above:bar_high reaches the same new high and I act on it. A 1.4x volume clause is not my test (day_vol 1.2 is a proxy to me, R5); I would not add it, and if the room adds it I keep SUPPORT. Whether minervini stays a why_agreed voice is his to say. Wrong if a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high (C7, my translation).
